name: Lepracaun
gmNotes: A Lepracaun is a Grace broker or related administrative role — not a biological species. When an exchange moves value between currencies, record two Grace Ledger entries: a negative amount in the currency given and a positive amount in the currency received, on the same day, with the same reason naming the rate. Wealthy Lepracauns may own expensive four-emitter cloaking glamour; leg-mounted emitters are unreliable. A broker who knowingly offers unusable glamour-gold is committing deliberate fraud rather than an innocent category error. The Archetype grants no automatic abilities; consult the searchable Grace and Fey technology dossiers for detail.
description: A fairy who trades in favors and keeps the books of the Otherworld — who owes what, which debt is paid, and which promise was never kept. Lepracauns are brokers and administrators of the fairy economy, not the mischief-makers of the stories.
